runtimeManifest.runCoordination: Run scenarios serially under a bounded read-only observer. The floating smoke requires the optional fresh-window-observation handshake; the controls smoke runs with floating opt-in absent. Preserve every outcome.

preparation.readinessMeaning: Input and protocol preparation is finalized only. Fresh session/display/process readiness must still pass inside the observer before its single launch.
preparation.commandChange: Runtime2 manifest already binds the new shell archive and fresh run3 output. The same frozen runner is used with pinned .venv interpreter and -B.

schema.targetPID: positive integer, exact bound native PID

windowObservationProtocol.publication: Only after the retained observation passes all existing identity/session/display/resource/query-deadline guards. Require currently bound exact runtime2 PID/path and actual positive target windows wholly within an awake display. Fsync retained observation and a fresh temporary JSON, then atomically replace final proof file. Record publication payload/hash and sample index.
windowObservationProtocol.nativeProof: Immediately before each original timestamped menu/button request, shell records requestLabel-observer-window-ready with waitStartedUptime, accepted hostSeconds and the exact matching window only. Require new query start >= wait start, query end >= start and <= native acceptance, age <=2s, exact process and target window.
windowObservationProtocol.independentAudits: Preserve strict query-END<=actual-request-time gate. Match every consumed proof to exactly one retained validated sample/publication and its exact window projection, with waitStart<=queryStart<=queryEnd<=accepted<=request and same target window. Both audits run even when the frozen runner fails; audit errors stay separate from original native/runner failure. Independently require accepted-waitStart <5s, matching the shell wait bound.
windowObservationProtocol.absence: No proof is fabricated for a nonpositive or unbound sample. A previously published proof cannot satisfy a new query-start requirement; shell wait is bounded at five seconds.

preservedFailureScope.attempt1: Own child can start between process queries; original readiness failure and cleanup EPERM retained with scoped diagnosis/observer2 CPU regressions.
preservedFailureScope.attempt2: 24 native checks passed, strict pending-zero pause settle failed; 44 stable paused states. Six of seven earlier target-window witnesses existed; this is not retroactively relabeled.

preparedChecks.name: explicit native acceptance elapsed below five seconds matches shell protocol

preparation.validationScope: Read-only AST parsing, source comparison and artifact hashes only. No observer import/execution, tests, native player, build or model launch. Root owns final review and any launch.
limitations: Earlier untimestamped DOM setup is not covered by the native action handshake.
Window proof is sampled metadata and bounded action ordering, not continuous uncovered pixels, compositor callbacks, physical input/HDR/A/V, sleep/VoiceOver, or M5 qualification.
File pins do not prove loaded-image identity or actual GPU busy/idle state.
The previous nine CPU regressions apply to observer2 discovery/cleanup; no claim is made that they test new observer3 handshake code.
readOnlyReviews: Root and zero_transport reviewed publication, exact proof/sample binding, strict retrospective gate, and failure-preserving finally integration; no blocker reported. Explicit five-second acceptance audit was then added as requested.

previousFailedControl.scope: Original strict-pending failure and retrospective 6/7 window limitation remain unchanged. Prospective runtime2 allows bounded stable accepted frames awaiting emission after ordinary Pause and uses fresh per-action window observations.

counterInterpretation.completed-frames: Emitted downstream output counter; not GPU-future completion.
counterInterpretation.pending-frames: Accepted frames awaiting emission, including the preview term; completed work can remain queued.
counterInterpretation.arithmetic: Do not infer submitted minus emitted equals pending across resets and prior generations.
counterInterpretation.gpuCompletionInventory: Not established by these counters or the export.

The separate strict prior-query-end-before-request gate remains; this proves sampled metadata and request ordering, not continuous physical visibility.

Intentional window resize, minimize, close, return and fullscreen transitions are allowed. No all-interval visibility claim is made; unchanged frozen native checks retain their own phase-specific window requirements.

RSS covers the observed runner process group, PPID descendants and retained known descendants; independently managed XPC services and GPU allocations are not attributable through this process-tree metric.
Competing-work detection covers named native/build programs, not arbitrary unrecognized model workloads. The run still requires serialized local GPU/model work.
Pins establish unchanged input files. The runner's --shared argument hashes a path; existing native linkage selects the loaded image. This observer does not claim loaded-image identity.

limitations: OS target-window metadata is sampled, not continuous. On-screen flags do not prove uncovered pixels, compositor callbacks, physical HDR or A/V synchronization.
The frozen ordinary-controls scenario starts its DOM/media setup without an external readiness handshake. Sampled native-window observations cannot gate or prove visibility before that setup.
This ordinary-controls scenario has no native menu/button handshake or prior-setup gate. Frozen DOM/media acceptance and teardown checks are preserved. Physical input delivery is not qualified.

Intentional window resize, minimize, close, return and fullscreen transitions are allowed. No all-interval visibility claim is made; unchanged frozen native checks retain their own phase-specific window requirements.

RSS covers the observed runner process group, PPID descendants and retained known descendants; independently managed XPC services and GPU allocations are not attributable through this process-tree metric.
Competing-work detection covers named native/build programs, not arbitrary unrecognized model workloads. The run still requires serialized local GPU/model work.
Pins establish unchanged input files. The runner's --shared argument hashes a path; existing native linkage selects the loaded image. This observer does not claim loaded-image identity.
